Emitting Domain Events

Where ticket.service.js and comment.service.js call emit() — always after the write succeeds, carrying whatever payload the listeners need.

  • ticket.created: Emit After the Write

    createTicket still does exactly one job of its own — insert the row — and adds a single emit() once that's actually committed.

  • Diffing Against the Previous State

    ticket.assigned and ticket.status_changed only fire on a genuine change — which means updateTicket needs to know what the ticket looked like before.

  • ticket.commented: Resolving Recipients Once

    Who should hear about a new comment — the customer plus opted-in watchers, minus whoever just wrote it — worked out once, here, not by every listener.
